svg.title: Tears of Steel: dialogue and descriptions
svg.desc: 34 descriptions, 154 seconds of narration, each placed between lines of dialogue.
svg.text: Tears of Steel: where aloud speaks
34 descriptions, 2.6 minutes of narration. Dialogue as the film's own production stems hear it.

rect.title: 0:11 Rocket engines ignite, blasting bright white flames and pinkish plumes from their nozzles.
